title: Banks Act Circular C3/2013 — Interpretation and application of criteria relating to effective maturity
enablingLegislation: Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This circular is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(4) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Interpretation and application of criteria relating to effective maturity.

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This circular applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Interpretation and application of criteria relating to effective maturity.

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Interpretation and application of criteria relating to effective maturity. Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This circular remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
